items.text: StoreError has a documented ReadOnly variant carrying the store's directory and the refused act.
StoreError has a documented RepairPending variant carrying the store's directory, the pinned tree size and the extent.
FileLeafStore::open_read_only performs FileLeafStore::open's checks and returns a handle without flushing leaves/ or writing any file.
FileLeafStore::open_read_only on a store exactly one leaf past its pin returns StoreError::RepairPending and every file under the store directory holds the same bytes before and after.
put_leaf on a handle from FileLeafStore::open_read_only returns StoreError::ReadOnly and every file under the store directory holds the same bytes before and after.
pin on a handle from FileLeafStore::open_read_only returns StoreError::ReadOnly and every file under the store directory holds the same bytes before and after.
A store one leaf past its pin, the state a read-only open refuses with RepairPending, is repaired by FileLeafStore::open followed by Log::open, which reports recovered_to as Some of the extent.
StoreError has two new variants, ReadOnly and RepairPending, neither of which carries or prints a leaf index, and no existing variant's fields or message changes.

FileLeafStore::open_read_only is a documented inherent constructor that refuses what FileLeafStore::open refuses with the same errors, reports the same leftover temporary files, and never flushes, creates, writes, renames, links or removes a file, leftover temporary files included, and the LeafStore trait has the same methods as on main.
put_leaf through a handle from FileLeafStore::open_read_only returns StoreError::ReadOnly and changes no byte of the store.
pin through a handle from FileLeafStore::open_read_only returns StoreError::ReadOnly before any other pin check and changes no byte of the store.
FileLeafStore::open_read_only over a store whose leaf count is past its pinned tree size returns StoreError::RepairPending, reads no leaf byte and changes no byte of the store.

A store that FileLeafStore::open_read_only refused with StoreError::RepairPending, opened with FileLeafStore::open and Log::open, is repaired and the repair is reported through recovered_to, as on main.
The module doc of crates/lys-log-store/src/file.rs states what open and open_read_only do and never do, including that open never deletes a leftover temporary file.
A torn leaf inside the pinned prefix is refused by Log::open with StoreError::PinMismatch carrying both trees, and state.json is unchanged.
A torn leaf just past the pin is adopted by the one-leaf repair and reported by recovered_to.
FileLeafStore::leftover_temporaries returns the store's temporary-leaf names in lexical order, none counted toward the extent and none changed.
file.rs's module doc has a section stating what open and open_read_only do and never do, including that neither deletes a leftover temporary file.
file.rs's module doc states that FileLeafStore::leaf serves bytes it has not checked and that a leaf is proven whole only through Log::open against the pinned root.

sections.name: Proofs never hold the whole log

items.text: A hash-only proof tree built by streaming (LYSLOGSTORE-005 R1), proved by a counting test that fails at the base.

sections.name: A proof reads tiles, never the whole log (LYSLOGSTORE-006)

items.text: Every append writes its hashes into C2SP tiles before the pin (LYSLOGSTORE-006 R1).
Inclusion and consistency proofs read only the tiles they need, and the whole-log proof tree is gone (LYSLOGSTORE-006 R2).
A log made before tiles gets them once, and never again (LYSLOGSTORE-006 R3).
A gate test fails when a start or its first proof reads a leaf before the tail (LYSLOGSTORE-006 R4).
A receipt's coordinate is read from the tiles and the growing checkpoints are removed (LYSLOGSTORE-006 R5).
A frontier log opens from its tiles and reads no leaf under the pin (LYSLOGSTORE-007 R1).
Artifacts are built from a tile proof and a root, byte-for-byte as from a whole tree (LYSLOGSTORE-007 R2).
The anchor opens, creates, reads and proves through the frontier log and its tiles (LYSLOGSTORE-007 R3).
The lys log and ca log commands and the revocation appends run on the frontier log (LYSLOGSTORE-007 R4).
Only lys log audit reads every leaf, and the whole-tree Log is removed (LYSLOGSTORE-007 R5).
A gate test fails when any open reads a leaf under the pin (LYSLOGSTORE-007 R6).
Leaves are appended as length-prefixed, checksummed records to segment files rolled at a fixed size, and leaf() reads one record by its offset (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R1).
The pin is written inside the leaf's record, one flush makes both durable, and state.json is no longer rewritten (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R2).
FrontierLog::append_batch writes many records with one flush, and the fixtures and bulk writers use it (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R3).
A per-file store is migrated once on its first writable open, and a crash at any point leaves the old store whole or the new store complete (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R4).
A crash at every write, flush and rename boundary of an append, a batch and the migration loses no acknowledged leaf and shows no unacknowledged one (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R5).
Gate tests count one flush per append and per batch, and an open of 10,000 records reads only the tail (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R6).
Every store on the log counts one flush per acknowledged act in the gate (LYSLOGSTORE-008 R7).
Every name Lys creates under its data path has a row with its creator, contract, open, growing collections and bytes per act, and a test holds the list whole (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R1).
No production open reads every leaf, and Log with its full-leaf opens is deleted (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R2).
The runner's operations open from a checkpoint and their live outcomes, rewritten with one flush (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R3).
A migration's kept copy is removed while running once a later start has checked it, and a mismatch is refused and kept (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R4).
A bound test drives a stated mix to 2,000 sessions and measures the data path from outside, red at main (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R5).
Every growing in-process collection holds only live records or contract-kept ids (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R6).
Installed, with the data path's levels posted over seven days beside the acts counted (LYSLOGSTORE-009 R7).
